title: Action with Visual Primitives
abstract: arXiv:2605.22183v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for generalist robotic manipulation. A common design in current architectures maps language instructions and visual observations to actions in a single forward pass. While conceptually simple, this formulation entangles instruction comprehension, spatial scene understanding, and motor control within a single learning objective. As a result, the action expert must implicitly relearn cognitive and perceptual capabilities already present in the pretrained VLM, which can limit both learning efficiency and generalization. We introduce AVP (Action with Visual Primitives), an end-to-end architecture that implements this visual-primitive-centric interface: the VLM infers the next-stage target and emits visual-primitive tokens that condition a flow-matching action expert, with supervision derived from end-effector kinematics. translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为通用机器人操作的一种有前景的范式。当前架构中的一种常见设计是在单次前向传播中将语言指令和视觉观测映射为动作。尽管概念上简单，这种表述将指令理解、空间场景理解和运动控制纠缠在单一学习目标中。因此，动作专家必须隐式地重新学习预训练VLM中已经具备的认知和感知能力，这可能同时限制学习效率和泛化能力。我们提出了AVP（基于视觉原语的动作），这是一种实现以视觉原语为中心接口的端到端架构：VLM推断下一阶段目标并发出视觉原语token，这些token用于条件化一个流匹配动作专家，其监督信号来自末端执行器运动学。在通用抓取任务上的真实机器人实验（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出AVP端到端架构，通过让VLM发出视觉原语token来条件化流匹配动作专家，将认知感知与运动控制解耦，从而提升机器人操作的学习效率和泛化能力。
en_tdlr: AVP is an end-to-end architecture that decouples cognition from motor control by having the VLM emit visual-primitive tokens to condition a flow-matching action expert, improving learning efficiency and generalization in robotic manipulation.
